claims: The 2026 Men's NCAA Final Four will be held at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis, Indiana.
Games of the 2026 Men's NCAA Final Four will occur on April 4 and April 6, 2026.
Lucas Oil Stadium is a regular host for the tournament.
Lucas Oil Stadium will feature the national semifinals and championship game.
The 2026 Men's Final Four is hosted by Horizon League and IU Indianapolis.
The dates of the 2026 Men's Final Four are April 4–6, 2026.
The 2026 Women's Final Four will be held in Phoenix, Arizona.
